title: gf2-sim crate scaffolding (Pipeline, Stage, Connector primitives)
description:
## Goal

Stand up the new `gf2-sim` crate with the scaffolding agreed in the
Phase 0 design doc: `Pipeline`, `Stage`, `Connector` primitives,
batch types, error types, `PipelineConfig`, `observability` stub, and
the pre-allocated module skeleton that lets Wave A.2 fan out without
merge conflict.

## Context

Task under story `bcf7776d` (CPU foundation) within epic `gf2-sim`
(`f9717e7e`). Phase 0 design doc:
`dev/active/ec530af9-pipeline-design.md` §1 (module skeleton)
and §5 (crate-boundary diagram) are the canonical reference for the
deliverables here. Wave A.1: this task is the only one in the wave;
must complete before Wave A.2 (`3fcb7025`, `81d05bab`, `c09d3e95`,
`db9836e4`) starts.

## Deliverables

1. New crate `crates/gf2-sim/` with `Cargo.toml` per design-doc §5:
   - workspace member added to root `Cargo.toml`
   - deps: `gf2-core`, `gf2-coding`, `rayon`, `rand_chacha`, `tracing`,
     `serde`
   - optional dep: `gf2-kernels-hip` behind feature `hip`
   - features: `default = []`, `hip = ["dep:gf2-kernels-hip"]`,
     `llr-f64 = []`
   - `#![deny(unsafe_code)]` at the top of `src/lib.rs`.
2. Module skeleton from design-doc §1, with empty stubs in each
   directory so subsequent Wave A.2 / Phase B / Phase C tasks have
   non-conflicting module homes:

   ```
   crates/gf2-sim/src/
     lib.rs, pipeline.rs, stage.rs, error.rs, config.rs,
     observability.rs,
     parallel/mod.rs, presets/{mod.rs,dvb_t2.rs},
     graph/mod.rs, channels/{mod.rs,awgn.rs,rayleigh.rs,rician.rs},
     checkpoint/mod.rs, executor/mod.rs, gpu/mod.rs
   ```

3. Trait + type definitions from design-doc §1 lifted to code:
   `Stage<I, O>`, `Connector<T>`, `Pipeline`, `PipelineConfig`,
   `StageError`, `RecoverableError`, `FatalError`, `ExecutionClass`,
   `BatchHandle`, `AnyStage` (type-erased trait object boilerplate).
4. `PipelineConfig` is the v2 successor to
   `gf2_coding::simulation::SimulationConfig`; field set per
   design-doc §12. Conversion `From<SimulationConfig>` provided so
   `bbf6b6ee` migration is mechanical.
5. `observability::install_campaign_subscriber()` stub matching the
   signature used in `crates/gf2-coding/src/bin/dvb_t2_awgn_campaign.rs`
   so the campaign binary can call into the new crate without churn
   when `bbf6b6ee` lands.
6. Receipts directory bootstrap: create
   `dev/benchmarks/gf2-sim/README.md` with a short index pointing to
   the per-phase receipt files (`cpu-foundation-receipts.md`,
   `gpu-stages-receipts.md`, `hybrid-executor-receipts.md`,
   `parallelism-receipts.md`, `5g-nr-realtime.md`, `comparison/`).
   This resolves audit finding M1 (no task owned the receipts dir
   creation).
7. CLAUDE.md amendment: add `gf2-sim` to the "Architecture" crate list
   (with one-line summary and feature table) and to the "Test tiers"
   section as appropriate. Do NOT amend the determinism contract
   section yet — Phase 0 design doc §11 is the SSOT for that, and the
   amendment lands when `48a0db6c` (the determinism test suite)
   closes Phase A.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] `cargo build --workspace --all-features --release` builds
  the new crate clean (zero warnings).
- [hard] `cargo test -p gf2-sim --release` passes (empty test suite is
  acceptable; subsequent tasks add tests).
- [hard] `cargo clippy -p gf2-sim --all-targets -- -D warnings` green.
- [hard] `dev/benchmarks/gf2-sim/README.md` exists with the index
  described in deliverable 6.
- [hard] `CLAUDE.md` lists `gf2-sim` in the workspace crate table with
  the "CPU+GPU pipeline" summary and the feature table.
- [hard] `cargo doc --no-deps -p gf2-sim` produces rustdoc without
  warnings; every public item has the doc-comment skeleton (full doc
  body filled in by the owning sub-task).
- [hard] No new `unsafe` outside `gf2-kernels-hip`; `gf2-sim` is
  `#![deny(unsafe_code)]`.
- [hard] `cargo-ci`, `code-review` gates green.

## Non-goals

- No parallel dispatch logic (owned by `3fcb7025`).
- No channel implementations (owned by `db9836e4`).
- No GPU code (owned by Phase B `36075e4c`).
- No preset content (owned by `81d05bab`).
- No graph API content (owned by `c09d3e95`).
- No tests beyond a smoke build check.
